purpose: Scale MouldMaster beyond the first 20 research passes and 50-pass measured-evidence atlas while prioritising traceable measured evidence over raw synthetic volume. Preserve the first two 100-pass Deep Dive waves and add a distinct third 100-pass wave for 300 cumulative evidence domains.

execution_state.completion_boundary: Execution passes are evidence-discovery domains, not a claim that the 2,000-paper or 1,000-primary-study corpus targets are complete.

principles: Measured evidence and provenance outrank synthetic-row count.
Do not convert paper-specific settings into universal production recipes.
Keep public measured-data benchmark work separate from authorised site data.
Preserve cavity, machine, material, sensor-location and shot identity whenever the source provides them.
Prediction, association, diagnosis and causality are distinct evidence claims.
Third-party raw files are not committed unless licence and governance explicitly permit redistribution.

evidence_levels.E1: Mechanism supported by authoritative engineering, regulator, supplier or textbook evidence.
evidence_levels.E2: At least one primary peer-reviewed measured experiment supports the mechanism.
evidence_levels.E3: Multiple independent measured studies support the mechanism.
evidence_levels.E4: Reusable raw dataset has been independently profiled and fingerprinted by MouldMaster.
evidence_levels.E5: Relationship has been reproduced on more than one independent measured dataset.
evidence_levels.E6: Relationship has also been validated against authorised de-identified production-site evidence.

priority_order: quality, MSA, SPC and advanced statistics
AI, uncertainty, drift, transfer and causal boundaries
specialist optical, medical, LSR, thermoset and composite modules
release_rule: The targets are programme goals, not automatic release blockers. Release QA must verify the ledger exists, counts are not silently reduced, evidence maturity is declared for additions, and measured/synthetic provenance remains explicit.
